investment_theses.thesis: Bitcoin outperforms traditional safe-haven assets (TLT, GLD) through 2026-09-30 as central banks signal pivot to rate cuts amid consumer demand destruction.
supporting_signals: Consumer Confidence Index (81.9) at lowest since 2014; homeowners refusing to deploy $M housing wealth despite record equity
CoinDesk 'Bitcoin beats gold, surge to $100,000 in play' + 'rates rise, consumer confidence plunges' (inverse correlation to demand expectations)
CNBC Fed rate cut expectations embedded in bond market despite higher yields
investment_theses.counter_view: Bond yields rising (not falling) and long-duration assets (TLT) may outperform BTC if risk-free rates stay elevated; crypto adoption lagging among broke consumers.
investment_theses.expression: Long BTC/USD spot or BTC perps vs. short TLT (20-year Treasuries) or GLD (gold ETF); ratio trade BTC:GLD

investment_theses.thesis: Ethereum outperforms Bitcoin on institutional adoption tailwinds (tokenized derivatives, privacy upgrades, DeFi strength) despite macro headwinds through 2026-09-30.
supporting_signals: Cboe/S&P Dow Jones exploring tokenized options contracts under extended licensing deal (institutional on-ramp)
zk.money privacy returns after 3 years + Zcash Tachyon code moving into Ethereum ecosystem
Aave leading DeFi higher despite rising bond yields (demand for yield generation, not risk-off)
investment_theses.counter_view: Tokenized options won't see meaningful volume for 12+ months; Aave outperformance may be mean reversion, not trend; Ethereum execution risk (Shanghai scaling delays).
investment_theses.expression: Long ETH spot or ETH perps; overweight Aave (AAVE) via spot or perps; short BTC or long ETH/BTC ratio

investment_theses.thesis: U.S. Consumer Discretionary sector (XLY) underperforms by >500bps through 2026-09-30 as auto-enrollment programs (Trump Accounts) and loan refinancing divert consumer liquidity away from DTC retail.
supporting_signals: Conference Board Consumer Confidence at 81.9 (6.7-point miss on forecast 89) — lowest since 2014
CNBC 'homeowners sitting on record equity and not using it' — demand destruction signal
Treasury auto-enrolling 60M children into Trump Accounts; Education Department extending student loan relief — demographic shifts toward savings over spending
investment_theses.counter_view: Auto-enrollment is revenue neutral to consumer (money shifted, not lost); Trump Accounts may boost confidence in governance; Q2-Q3 GDP data could surprise upside.
investment_theses.expression: Short XLY (Consumer Discretionary ETF) or long SPY/short XLY pair trade; overweight XLP (Staples)

investment_theses.thesis: Tech mega-cap valuations (NVDA, META, TSLA) face compression through 2026-12-31 if voluntary AI guardrails fail and regulatory backlash accelerates, decoupling from AI infrastructure plays.

Hacker News top story: 'DraftKings using AI to behaviorally target chronic gamblers' (regulatory friction imminent)
Speaker Johnson signals voluntary guardrails, not mandates — credibility of self-regulation weakening
investment_theses.counter_view: Trump admin already signaling light-touch regulation; AI capex cycle just beginning; NVDA/META earnings likely beat estimates in 2026.
investment_theses.expression: Short QQQ or overweight defensive Tech (FTCH, CRM) vs. long chip capacity plays (TSM, ASML); short NVDA vs. long MSTR (Bitcoin proxy, asymmetric upside on rate cuts)

investment_theses.thesis: Crypto infrastructure IPO plays (Blockchain.com target $6B valuation) outperform traditional fintech through 2026-12-31 as institutional adoption accelerates via ETF rails and tokenized derivatives.

Bitwise launches spot NEAR ETF (institutional entry point); Cboe tokenized options deal extends
Democrats killed Clarity Act, removing near-term regulatory overhang; crypto trending tokens (NEAR, AAVE, QNT) outperforming
